basic_info.description: Welcome home to 5160 Diamond Heights Blvd #208C! This unit is nestled within a wonderful community in Diamond Heights. This condominium boasts 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and approximately 1,175 square feet of living space. This unit has a great floor plan, including a built in bar near the dining area, impeccable views and natural light from the living room windows, a cozy, gas-burning fireplace and ample closet space for convenience. Enjoy living within a serene community with landscaped grounds, bridges, waterfalls & lush greenery throughout. The extra amenities also include an outdoor heated swimming pool, spa, sauna, full fitness center, a clubhouse with a pool table & fireplace, a one car deeded parking space & a communal laundry room. Located within walking distance to the Diamond Heights shopping center and the recently renovated George Christopher Playground. Easy access to Glen Park BART, and HWYS 101/280 for commuting. Don't miss this amazing opportunity to live in one of the best areas of San Francisco!
